thread:
jiayi: heads-up — spun up a shadow bring-up for calypso-lite-v2 int4 (q4-ish) on staging, running our ml10 zh->en eval.

jiayi: eval-bot posted results: \n```\nmodel: calypso-lite-v2-q4\nsuite: ml10-zh-en\nbaseline (fp16) BLEU: 28.7\nshadow (int4) BLEU: 25.2  # -3.5 absolute\nchrF+: 56.1 -> 52.4\nexamples failing: 1.8% -> 5.6% (high-error tail)\n```

matt: ouch that's a pretty big drop for an int4 smoke. any obvious diffs in tokenization? :eyes:

jiayi: i'm seeing a token boundary mismatch on ideographic punctuation and ZWSPs. quick diff on tokenizer outputs for a failing sample:

```\ninput: "\u5317\u4eac\u5e02\uff1a\u4eca\u5929\u7684\u5929\u6c14\u4e0d\u9519\u3002"\nfp16 tokens: ["\u5317\u4eac", "\u5e02", "\uff1a", "\u4eca\u5929", "\u7684", "\u5929\u6c14", "\u4e0d\u9519", "\u3002"]\nint4 tokens: ["\u5317\u4eac", "\u5e02\uff1a", "\u4eca\u5929", "\u7684", "\u5929\u6c14", "\u4e0d\u9519", "\u3002"]\n# int4 merged the fullwidth colon with previous han char -> shifts subtoken alignment\n```

anya: is that from a changed tokenizer or from quant packing altering tokenization lookup? sounds like a tokenmap hash collision or fallback path.

jiayi: tokenizer binary same as baseline. hypothesis: the quantized embedding table has aliasing for rare punctuation subtokens so decoding merges adjacent subtokens during detokenization when using the compact cache path.

sam: can you run a quick pass that forces fp16 tokenization + int4 inference (i.e., tokenize with baseline but run model with int4 weights)? helps isolate tokenization vs model decode issue.

jiayi: ran that. forced baseline tokenization + int4 decode gives BLEU 27.9 — much of the delta remains but smaller.

matt: so split of issue: ~1. -> tokenization alignment (1.0 BLEU?) and remainder -> model output distribution shift after quantization.

eval-bot: automated bisect triggered: \n```\nchanged layers: kernel rounding on embedding_lookup + softmax temperature clamp at kernel v2.4\ncandidate: embedding table quantization rounding fix reduces KL divergence on logits by 0.8\n```

anya: do we have small repro that shows the detokenization merge? paste one failing pair (ref / fp16 / int4)

jiayi: pasted minimal repro below:

```\nref: "Beijing: the weather is nice today."\nfp16: "Beijing: the weather is nice today."\nint4: "Beijing the weather is nice today."  # colon dropped/attached to token causing missing punctuation in output -> BLEU penalized\n```

sam: hmm punctuation loss can cascade scoring heavily for short sentences. also affects alignment for chrF.

matt: next steps?

jiayi: plan:
- run targeted tokenmap unit tests with ZWSP/fullwidth punctuation corpus (@anya taking)
- try embedding_lookup rounding rollback on int4 candidate and rerun shadow (i'll run)
- add a detokenization parity check into bring-up smoke (deploy-bot pls) so future shadows fail fast

anya: i'll add the unit tests to ml-tokenizer repo and run locally. expect to catch the boundary merge in <2h.

deploy-bot: noted. creating rollout guard: detok-parity-check required for calypso-lite-v2 shadow -> will block canary until green.

jiayi: thanks — i'll post updated metrics when the int4 embedding-change run completes. thanks all :thumbsup:
